Starting commit: `8d5d29c` (end-of-session WU-003/004). WU-005/006 added since; current HEAD before this swarm includes WU-005/006 code. `@upstash/qstash` not yet installed at swarm start.

## Gate triggers

- **F1 (PII — fixed)**: `QueueError` message included `to=${req.to}` (recipient email). Fixed post-approve: removed `to=` from message, kept `category=` only. Coordinator applied fix directly (single-line change, no retry warranted).
- **F3 (Gate B rebuttal — added)**: `src/app/api/queue/deliver/route.ts` has no test file. Reviewer approved on the basis that it's construction glue with no testable logic. Added explicit rebuttal note to WU done/ file per Gate B protocol.
- **Reviewer "missing test file" (NOT stale this time)**: reviewer ran AFTER tester completed — no timing artifact. Reviewer correctly observed test file present and passed.

## Test gate

✓ vitest gate passed — 220 tests, 14 test files, 0 failures.
Gate A: `npx vitest run` exits 0.
Gate B: `src/queue/index.ts` covered by `src/queue/index.test.ts` (colocated). `src/app/api/queue/deliver/route.ts` — no test file; rebuttal recorded in WU notes (pure construction wiring, no logic).

## What shipped

- `src/queue/index.ts` — `createQueue({ publisher: QStashPublisher, deliverUrl })` returning `{ enqueue(req): Promise<{ jobId }> }`. `createDeliverHandler({ mailSender })` returning a Fetch-style handler: 400 on bad JSON, 500 on send failure/throw, 200 on success. `QueueError`, `isQueueError`, `QStashPublisher` interface, `MailSenderForHandler` interface.
- `src/app/api/queue/deliver/route.ts` — thin glue: constructs router/logWriter/mailSender, exports `POST = verifySignatureAppRouter(createDeliverHandler({ mailSender }))`.

## What didn't ship

AC-3 (invalid signature → 401) is satisfied by `verifySignatureAppRouter` SDK behaviour — no unit test written for it (we don't own that code).

## Decisions / open questions / risks filed during this run

- **Design B chosen over Design A** — injected handler factory; `createDeliverHandler` takes `mailSender` arg instead of constructing dependencies internally. Enables direct unit testing without module-level mocking. Full rationale in WU notes.
- **`verifySignatureAppRouter` at `@upstash/qstash/nextjs`** — not at the top-level package export. Confirmed post-install via node inspection. Coder note in WU logs.
- **`logWriter` adapter pattern** (F2) — `writeSendAttempt` returns `Promise<{ id: string }>`, `SendLogWriter` expects `Promise<void>`. TypeScript strict mode requires `.then(() => undefined)` wrapper at call site. WU-008 planning note: extract `createLogWriter()` factory before that WU ships to avoid a second identical inline adapter.
- **PII discipline** — `QueueError` error messages must not include `to` (recipient email). Applies to all future error messages in this codebase. Enforced post-approve in this WU.

## Notes / observations

Most expensive swarm run so far — architect (Opus) on a genuinely novel integration (QStash SDK, first API route in the codebase) justified the cost. The design-it-twice process produced a concrete, testable insight: Design B's no-module-mock advantage proved out in the tester pass (31 tests, zero `vi.mock` calls). The `vi.hoisted()` pattern from WU-006 was not needed here — DI made it unnecessary. PII discipline note is now a standing rule for error messages project-wide.
